title: Internal bar cocycle roofs and the normalized derived adjunction
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring on the small coherent profinite site, and $G$ a profinite group. Use internal $A$-modules and equivariant internal modules with the definitions and universes of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-sfb-condensed-action-module, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $P_n=A[\underline G^{n+1}]$, with diagonal action, deletion differential $\partial$, and augmentation $e:P_0\to A$, be the homogeneous resolution of [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution]. Regard it as a cochain complex $P^{-n}=P_n$, $d_P^{-n}=\partial_n$. Let $N$ be an equivariant module. Write $V^p(N)=\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[\underline G^p],N)$ with the action-dependent inhomogeneous differential. Use the normalized compatible derived total $\mathscr B(N)$, map $j_N:V^\bullet(N)\to\mathscr B(N)$, and augmentation isomorphism $\epsilon_N:R\Gamma_G(N[0])\to\mathscr B(N)$ of [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-invariant-bar]. Use the canonical derived adjunction of trivial inflation $L$ and invariants $R\Gamma_G$ of [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus], in ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

For every $q\geq0$ and every equivariant $A$-linear map $f:P_q\to N$ with $f\partial_{q+1}=0$, let $\bar f:P\to N[q]$ have its only possibly nonzero component $f$ in degree $-q$. Its derived roof is $Q(\bar f)Q(e)^{-1}:A\to N[q]$. Let $c_f:A[-q]\to V^\bullet(N)$ be the cochain map corresponding to $f$ under
$$f[g_0,\ldots,g_q]=g_0\,c_f(g_0^{-1}g_1,\ldots,g_{q-1}^{-1}g_q).$$
There are signs $s_q\in\{1,-1\}$, depending only on the fixed cochain, shift and total-Hom conventions, with $s_0=s_1=1$, such that
$$j_Nc_f=s_q\,\epsilon_N\Phi_q\bigl(Q(\bar f)Q(e)^{-1}\bigr).$$
Here $Q$ inverts quasi-isomorphisms and $\Phi_q:\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A_G(A))}(A,N[q])\to\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\operatorname{Mod}_A)}(A[-q],R\Gamma_G(N))$ is the shift of the canonical derived adjunction bijection. The signs are independent of $A,G,N,f$.

For a short exact equivariant sequence $0\to N\xrightarrow{i}E\xrightarrow{p}A\to0$ and an equivariant map $\ell:P_0\to E$ with $p\ell=e$, write $f:P_1\to N$ for the unique map with $if=\ell\partial_1$. Its roof is the connecting arrow $A\to N[1]$ of that sequence, with the usual connecting sign normalized by this formula. No projectivity of $P_n$, exactness of global sections, or underived internal-Hom acyclicity is assumed.
